eva_docs: Drafting a short update for SOC2/audit-logs about tenant migration and retention. Want to lock wording + snippets before PR.
matt_security: Use 'tenant migration' wording. Add sentence that legal holds supersede TTL and that exports are customer's responsibility.
rachel_eng: For SDK v2 use `set_retention_policy` and `HoldsClient.create`. Holds return id and block TTL expiry. Also note exports are async.
eva_docs: Draft snippet below (py + curl). please confirm names.
```
# python
from redwood import AuditClient, HoldsClient
audit = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
audit.set_retention_policy(tenant_id="acct_mig_01", ttl_days=90)
hold = HoldsClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY").create(tenant_id="acct_mig_01", reason="due diligence")
print(hold.id)
```

```
# curl (async export, optional redaction)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct_mig_01","from":"2025-07-01","to":"2025-07-31","redact_sensitive":true}'
```
matt_security: Add sentence: "Exports created prior to or during migration remain the responsibility of the exporting party and must be secured per contract."
kevin_legal: LGTM. also suggest a one-line contract-friendly clause in an appendix.
